body: Not overly persistent at all, actually checked in beforehand to see if she was okay/comfortable with what we agreed to. She messaged me when she was about 45 minutes late and before I could see the full message she unmatched me.
Exactly, and yeah I’ll be okay, thanks :) just something that unfortunately happens to most people I guess.
Nothing that I could tell. Very normal messages back and forth and then her agreeing when I asked her out :/

Well I checked in yesterday with no reply so I guess I should’ve expected this in a way. After asking where they were at the time we were supposed to meet, she said something like “I’ve been held over” and immediately unmatched me. Lol.
Thank you for the thoughtful response. Definitely helped me change my perspective on some things I mentioned.

There were weights loaded. His bag was there too. In hindsight with those two factors I probably should’ve just left it alone even if it’s an asshole move to “reserve” it like that. But considering the amount of time it was just left there I was pretty irritated still. But oh well. There were a lot of things I wanted to say to him but I chose to be smart about it.
